_comment: Type A (atomic retrieval) questions from 'Graph RAG MVP Evaluation Questions and Benchmarking', v02 rev 2026.10.07. Questions and reference answers are taken verbatim from Table 1 of that document. Facets are this repo's deterministic restatement of each reference answer: one regex family per content point that the answer has to contain. Each question names its own paper, since the three Type A questions are about three different papers.

questions.question: Which autophagy-related gene was conditionally deleted in neural cells in the Hara et al. study?
questions.reference_answer: Atg5 was deleted in neural cells.

questions.question: Where do autophagosomes preferentially initiate in the primary-neuron system studied by Maday et al.?
questions.reference_answer: They preferentially initiate in the distal axon, near the neurite or axonal tip.
questions.facet_note: The reference answer's 'near the neurite or axonal tip' was dropped as a scored facet. It restates 'distal axon' rather than adding a content point, and matching it needed the literal word 'tip', so an answer saying 'the distal end of the axon' was marked wrong for using a synonym. That measures vocabulary, not retrieval.

questions.question: How did the rate of autophagosome formation change between young and advanced-aged neurons in Tsong et al.?
questions.reference_answer: It decreased markedly, with an approximately 70 percent reduction between neurons from young and advanced-aged mice in the reported DRG-neuron assay.
